## Services

### Exterior Detail
- Sedan / Coupe: $79
- SUV / Crossover / Minivan: $99
- Truck / Large SUV: $119
- Includes: Hand wash with professional-grade car shampoo, wheels and rims deep cleaned, UV-protective tyre dressing, door jamb wipe down, paint protection sealant, full exterior dry and finish

## About

Ashton's Auto Detail is a mobile car detailing business founded and operated by Ashton, a young local entrepreneur from the Cowichan Valley. Every job uses P&S professional-grade detailing chemicals, UV-protective tyre dressing, and paint protection sealant. The business comes directly to the customer's home or workplace anywhere in the Cowichan Valley region of British Columbia, Canada.
